newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-VENABLES TIGHT-LIPPED ON AUSTRALIAN JOB.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VENABLES TIGHT-LIPPED ON AUSTRALIAN JOB.

text.p: Former England coach Terry Venables on Tuesday refused to comment on reports that he had been offered the chance to coach the Australian national team.
The Herald Sun in Melbourne said Venables was "one of several high profile names " on Soccer Australia' s shopping list.
The Australians are believed to be interested in appointing two coaches, one based at home and one overseas to monitor some of the 150 Australians playing abroad.
But asked if he had been approached, Venables said: "I am just not discussing it."
"So many things have happened in the last few months and I don't want to discuss anybody else's business."
Venables quit as England coach after guiding them to the semifinals of Euro 96.
